data.title: Gates Foundation warns AI could widen inequality as foundation pledges $1B to expand access
data.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Bill Gates is warning technology companies and world leaders that they must act now to ensure artificial intelligence combats social inequities rather than deepening disparities — and his foundation is pledging $1 billion to improve access.
data.author: JAMES POLLARD — Associated Press
data.keywords: Associated Press, AP Technology, AP U.S. news, AP Business
